content.text: Found it. `AuthService.resetPassword` never revokes sessions, even though `SessionService.deleteByUserId` already exists.

candidates.explanation: After a successful password reset, the method only sets the new password and calls usersService.update. It never deletes the user's existing sessions. Refresh tokens are validated against the session rows (refresh() uses sessionService.updateByHash). Devices that were already signed in therefore keep valid sessions and can still renew their login after the reset. The password-change path in AuthService.update does call sessionService.deleteByUserIdWithExclude, so reset is inconsistent with it.

fix.description: After updating the password in resetPassword, revoke all of the user's sessions by calling `await this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id });`.
